title: 第25章 傀儡第26章 虫多势众
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
……
血屠将那封信看了几遍，血色的眼眸里没什么波澜，只觉得阿禾可真是大胆，居然要把他招上门。
虽然他不懂，凡人的一辈子那么短，有什么好在一起的。
不过他也想明白，阿禾应该没有背叛他，否则那些人早就现身了。
血屠将信收到怀里，刚刚的怒意已经散了大半。
罢了，她既没出卖他，不过是被吓破了胆跑了。那他就原谅她撞了他的事吧。
然而血屠忘了自己刚刚盛怒之下做的事情，望着周围的一片血色，他心里忽然有种莫名的不安。
阿禾没跑太远。
就跪在一群头颅面前。
血屠看着她失魂落魄的模样，更加不舒服了。
“有什么好跪的，脏死了……”
他根本就没看路边满地的尸体，那些人于他而言本就如蝼蚁。
至于是死是活，又与他何干？
“阿禾。”
他开口，声音依旧冷冽，却带着一丝不易察觉的紧绷。
却没人回应他。
血屠皱了皱眉，脸色更难看了，只是下一秒，他就愣在了原地。
阿禾死了，是吞石自尽。
怀里还抱着大黄那只蠢东西。
安静了两秒。

血屠冷着脸将它僵硬的尸体拎起来，随手丢在了一旁，任凭它发出了沉闷的声响。
然后，他伸手去探阿禾的脖颈，却只摸到了一处硬硬的凸起，很是硌人。
心口的位置似乎裂开了一道裂缝，冷风不断往里灌。
“好、好得很……”
血屠眼底的平静被彻底撕碎，翻涌着从未有过的怒意，甚至比之前以为自己被背叛时的还要严重几分。
明明他都没对她动手，她就非要这样跟他置气吗？！
血屠用魔气将人提起来，表情狠厉，目光却不敢仔细看她的表情。
许是怕看到悔意。
“是你将我带回来的，是福是祸，你都得受着！”
翻涌的魔气裹住阿禾的身体，并迅速钻进她的体内，使得原本毫无生气的她，竟慢慢有了细微的动静。
待魔气散去，阿禾终于睁开眼睛，眼底却没有任何神采，身体也失去了以往的温度。
content_en:
…
Xue Tu read the letter several times, and there was nothing in his blood-colored eyes. He just felt that Ah He was really bold and actually wanted to recruit him.
Although he doesn't understand, mortal life is so short, what's so good about being together.
But he also wanted to understand that Ah He should not have betrayed him, otherwise those people would have appeared long ago.
Xuetu received the letter in his arms, and most of his anger had dissipated.
Well, she didn't betray him, she was just frightened and ran away. Then he should forgive her for hitting him.
However, Xuetu forgot what he had just done in anger. Looking at the blood around him, he suddenly felt an inexplicable uneasiness in his heart.
Ah He didn't run too far.
Just kneeling in front of a group of heads.
Xue Tu looked at her devastated look and felt even more uncomfortable.
"What's there to kneel down on? It's so dirty..."
He didn't even look at the corpses on the roadside. Those people were like ants to him.
As for whether he is dead or alive, what does it have to do with him?
"Ahe."
He spoke, his voice still cold, but with a hint of unnoticeable tension.
But no one responded to him.
Xuetu frowned, his expression became even more ugly, but the next second, he froze on the spot.
Ah He died by swallowing a stone and committing suicide.
He was still holding that stupid big yellow thing in his arms.
It was quiet for two seconds.
Xue Tu picked up its stiff body with a cold face and threw it aside, letting it make a dull sound.
Then, he reached out to explore Ah He's neck, but only touched a hard bulge, which was very painful.
There seemed to be a crack in his heart, and cold wind kept pouring in.
"Okay, very good..."
The calmness in Xue Tu's eyes was completely torn apart, and anger surged like never before, even more serious than before when he thought he had been betrayed.
It's obvious that he didn't do anything to her, so she had to get angry with him like this? !
Xue Tu used his demonic energy to lift the person up with a stern expression on his face, but he did not dare to look at her expression carefully.
Maybe he was afraid of seeing regret.
"You are the one who brought me back. Whether it is a blessing or a curse, you have to suffer it!"
The surging demonic energy enveloped Ah He's body and quickly penetrated into her body, causing her originally lifeless body to slowly start to move slightly.
When the demonic energy dissipated, Ah He finally opened his eyes, but there was no look in them, and his body had lost its previous warmth.
